prompts.snow-white-pixelpop: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image: the normal Snow White illustration sheet, use it for consistent heroine face, dark wavy hair and red ribbon, cream-and-blue dress and jewel-tone gouache style. Create a NEW alternative PixelPop edition with much tighter framing and simplified shapes for a 64x32 LED panel. Twelve equally sized 2:1 wide panels in 4 columns by 3 rows, full-bleed no borders or gutters, no lettering. Exact reading-order subjects matching the reference: 1 heroine face filling frame with large red ribbon; 2 large blue songbird on leafy branch; 3 round cottage door and glowing window tight closeup; 4 pillow and seven simple colorful bed silhouettes; 5 one large rabbit with a bird beside it; 6 large single red apple against deep green; 7 large warm lantern amid dark forest silhouettes; 8 peacefully sleeping heroine face and pillow under simple arch of glass canopy; 9 kindly adult traveler face as he arrives; 10 waking heroine smiling face; 11 heroine and two welcoming miner faces with other friends as simple silhouettes; 12 one warmly glowing cottage window under large moon. One dominant subject per panel, subjects occupy 70-90 percent of frame. Bold outlines and broad color masses, minimal texture and no tiny details, strong bright-dark separation. Keep narrative sequence. Gentle bedtime story, original designs.
prompts.thumbelina-normal-matching: Use case: illustration-story. Create a normal-display iPad storybook edition of the tiny flower traveler story using the attached closeup sheet as a STYLE AND SEQUENCE reference. Consistent tiny fairy heroine: golden hair, green eyes, pink petal clothes and delicate shimmering wings. Rich vivid miniature garden paintings with cinematic warm light, original character design. Exactly twelve equally sized 2:1 landscape panels, arranged four columns by three rows, full-bleed no borders, gutters, text or watermarks. Reading-order scenes corresponding to the reference: 1 tiny girl waking inside pink blossom; 2 gentle hands holding her flower; 3 her leaf boat floating on stream; 4 friendly blue swallow guiding boat; 5 friendly mouse welcomes her through round green cottage door; 6 cozy cottage supper beneath glowing flower lantern; 7 winter meadow, girl bundled in red scarf, bright snowflakes; 8 girl and swallow resting warmly beside newly opening flower; 9 welcoming tiny garden folk offer her shimmering wings; 10 flower folk offer a golden leaf crown; 11 girl gently touches swallow wing in farewell; 12 girl sleeping inside pink blossom under full moon. Keep same subject beats as reference but widen views to show environments and story interactions. These are calm original storybook compositions for larger displays.
